== General Overview ==

=== Lifespan ===
The general lifespans for each stage are:

* '''Baby''': 1-4 hours, depending on how long it takes for a Babymarutchi to obtain four of the same Field Cell and for the user to interact with the Tama Cell to trigger the evolution
* '''Kid''': 24-28 hours
* '''Young''': 24 hours
* '''Adult''': Indefinite until death with neglect, breeding using the Tamagotchi Lab or Connection features, or selecting a new egg

=== Sleep Times ===
There is no prescribed wake and sleep schedule for the Tamagotchi Paradise; this device allows users to wake up or put it to sleep between a certain range of times, after which it will do so on its own. This applies to all stages besides the Baby Stage, with the baby taking the typical 5-minute nap after 30 minutes has passed from hatching.

* '''Morning''': The Tamagotchi can be woken up from 6:00 AM to 9:59 AM, after which it will wake up on its own.
* '''Evening''': The Tamagotchi can be put to sleep from 7:00 PM to 9:59 PM, after which it will go to sleep on its own.

=== Care Mistakes ===
Care mistakes are when the Tamagotchi calls for attention (indicated by the attention symbol appearing and a beep playing) and the user fails to address the cause of it within 15 minutes. The cause can be from either the hunger or happiness meter being empty or from the Tamagotchi being sick. Care mistakes are cumulative starting from the kid stage, and—for the first time outside of glitches or debugging the device—it is possible to keep track of them at any time in the Tama Cell View. Care mistakes are non-reversible on the Land, Water, Sky, and Jade versions; however, on the Tropics and Glacier versions, the Golden Peach snack obtained when completing a successful Egg Hunt (9 eggs) will reduce the current care mistake count by one when consumed.

=== Sickness ===
The Tamagotchi has a chance of becoming sick after a care mistake if the number of mistakes made is not divisible by 2 or 3 (ex: 1, 5, 7) and is dependent on the stage of the Tamagotchi. They may also get sick if six dark poops (made dark by staying on the field for an hour) are left on the screen. Once the Tamagotchi has become sick 5 times in one growth stage, they will die.

== Land, Water and Sky Versions ==

=== Baby Stage ===
Babymarutchi will take a 5-minute nap once 30 minutes has passed since hatching. It will also poop every 10 minutes, with users able to catch it by pressing any button when wiggle lines appear around it (this can be done either in Field or Tama View).

The rate of neediness is as follows:

* '''Hunger''': Drops by one every 3 minutes
* '''Happiness''': Drops by one every 5 minutes
* '''Sickness''': Always gets sick a single time 10 minutes after hatching

=== Kid Stage ===
The Kid Stage is determined by which [[Tama Field]] the user raises a Babymarutchi in. This is represented by a specific icon in the Tama Cell: leaves [[File:LandFieldCellIcon.png]] for Land, bubbles [[File:WaterFieldCellIcon.png]] for Water and clouds [[File:SkyFieldCellIcon.png]] for Sky. An icon is obtained for every 15 minutes a Babymarutchi spends in a specific field. If the first evolution prompt is missed, after 15 minutes the field type with the most cells will be removed. If multiple field cells have reached the amount of four, the earliest type obtained will be removed.

The rate of neediness for kids are:

* '''Hunger''': Decreases by one every 45 minutes
* '''Happiness''': Decreases by one every 20 minutes
* '''Sickness''': 35% chance after a care mistake

=== Young Stage ===
The Young Stage is determined both by Tama Field and the Tamagotchi's diet intake. During the Kid Stage, the Tama Field can be switched at any point, and the current Kid being raised will change to match that field after a certain amount of time; whichever associated icons are present in their cells at the time of evolution determines the group of species it can become.  Spending more than an hour consecutively in a specific field will trigger a change where all field cells are replaced with four cells from that field and the food cells are cleared.

Diet determines which specific species it will become within a group. Feeding certain foods increases a hidden point counter for certain types, with 5 points adding one food icon of that type to its cells. Up to 4 food icons can be present in the cells at a time (the oldest one added is replaced if another one is obtained past 4), and the food type with the highest count in the cells at the time of evolution will determine growth.

These food types are:

* [[File:MeatCellIcon.png]] = Meat: Obtained from Big Meat, Small Meat, or Steak.
* [[File:CarrotCellIcon.png]] = Carrot: Obtained from Carrots, Shredded Carrots, Apples, or Apple Pie.
* [[File:MealWormCellIcon.png]] = Worm: Obtained from Meal Bugs, Meal Worms, or Bug Cookies.
* [[File:SeafoodCellIcon.png]] = Seafood: Obtained from Seafood, Fried Fish, Shellfish, or Grilled Shellfish.
* [[File:SeaweedCellIcon.png]] = Seaweed: Obtained from Green Seaweed, Red Seaweed, or Seaweed Salad.
* [[File:PlanktonCellIcon.png]] = Plankton: Obtained from Meal Shrimp, Meal Plankton, or Plankton Dumplings.
* [[File:ChickenCellIcon.png]] = Chicken: Obtained from Whole Chicken, Piece of Chicken, or Chicken Steak.
* [[File:CornCellIcon.png]] = Corn: Obtained from Corn, Corn Flakes, Cherries, or Cherry Pie.
* [[File:SyrupCellIcon.png]] = Honey: Obtained from Flower Syrup, Honey Syrup, or Flower Drops.

: (Point values for each food can be found here: ''[[Tamagotchi Paradise/Item list#Meals|Tamagotchi Paradise/Item list]]'')

<nowiki>*</nowiki>Feeding only meals with no point value, such as the default Pellets, or having equal amounts of different food types present in the cell will result in a diet that is indeterminate and defaults to a certain species for each group (Sprout for Land, Float for Water, Rocky for Sky).

The rate of neediness for all Young characters is as follows:

* '''Hunger''': Decreases by one every 60 minutes
* '''Happiness''': Decreases by one every 30 minutes
* '''Sickness''': 35% chance after a care mistake

=== Adult Stage ===
The Adult Stage is determined by the species of Young raised, as well as care mistakes (represented by scribbles [[File:CareMissCellIcon.png]] in the Tama Cell, which max out at 6) and—for perfect-care characters—filling the Hunger and Happy meters 5 or more times (represented by rice ball [[File:HungerCellIcon.png]] and sun [[File:HappyCellIcon.png]] icons respectively).

There are 4 adults per species and one secret character per device color, totaling at 51 available base characters. All of these can be bred using the [[Tamagotchi Paradise#Breeding|Tamagotchi Lab]] feature or connection, and while color and eyes are passed on from the parents, the body is determined the same way as obtaining a base adult.

== Jade Forest Version ==
The Jade Forest version functions near-identically to the previous three versions. Users start in the [[Tama Field#Forest Field|Forest Field]] and unlock the Land Field and Water Field at later Planet Levels. The Sky Field is not present whatsoever, with most exclusive characters from it not appearing on the device.

Despite having the same names as other species of Young, the Forest variants can only evolve into adults exclusive to the Forest Field. Thus, raising one only fills out their entry present in the "Forest" section of the Tama File.

In addition to the Land and Water Field food types, the Jade Forest version has three unique food types obtainable in the Forest Field. These are:

* [[File:PomegranateCellIcon.png]] = Pomegranate: Obtained from Persimmon, Pomegranate, or Che Thai.

: (Point values for each food can be found here: ''[[Tamagotchi Paradise/Item list#Meals|Tamagotchi Paradise/Item list]]'')

The Orange Tropics and White Glacier versions start in the [[Tama Field#Tropical Field|Tropical Field]] and [[Tama Field#Ice Field|Ice Field]] respectively, with the other of the two and the Forest Field unlocking at later Planet Levels. The Land, Water and Sky Fields are not present whatsoever, with most exclusive characters from it not appearing on the device.

=== Young Stage ===
Despite having the same names as other species of Young, the Tropical and Ice variants can only evolve into adults exclusive to the Tropical and Ice Fields respectively. Thus, raising one only fills out their entry present in the "Tropical" or "Ice" section of the Tama File.

In addition to the Forest food types, the Tropics and Glacier versions have unique food types obtainable in the Tropical and Ice Fields. These are:
* [[File:TropicalMeat Cell Icon Paradise sprite.png]] = Tropical Meat: Obtained from Tropical Steak, Tropical Patty, or Hawaiian Burger.

== Lab Tama Exclusive ==
These characters are exclusively found at [[Deka Tamagotchi#Lab Tama|Lab Tama]] devices located at different stores around the world. Users can attempt to breed with them by playing a memory game, and if users succeed at all three rounds, the Lab Tama character will be impressed and the user is prompted to accept or deny the breeding proposal. If accepted, the two Tamagotchi characters will dance and produce an egg, which hatches with exclusive genes from the Lab Tama character—always guaranteeing that their eyes are passed down, but only sometimes their color. Their body cannot be obtained, as the actual characters themselves cannot be raised in any way.
